datum_note: USGS F01-4 block (5 parallel flight lines, 248 images), no ground control. Positions are detector candidates confirmed visually by Claude from crops (targets/top4_sheet.png); IDs assigned by consistent shift (all three ~1 m W, 5-8 m N); lead to re-confirm. SF15, SF19, SF20 (chalk marks) not identifiable at 5 cm; excluded. RTK horizontal datum not stated in the CSV (likely NAD83(2011), ~1-1.5 m from WGS84 here): part of the error may be datum, not map.
standard_note: ASPRS Positional Accuracy Standards Ed. 2 (2023) ask for at least 30 checkpoints for full compliance; this assessment uses n_checkpoints.

vertical_relative.reference: USGS RTK ground (TOPO) points, ellipsoid heights
vertical_relative.method: DTM minus surveyed ground height; std after removing the mean offset (absolute heights are off by offset_m; heights relative to nearby ground are good to about std_m)
